pages.text: "Is this the big station?" Bami looked around beside Dad. People with bags bustled beneath a high ceiling and huge ticking clock. Dad said, "Stay close. If you lose me, stop and call. I'll answer with a toot."
Colorful balloons floated below the clock. "I want to see!" Bami slipped away and ran over. While they gazed, Dad's footsteps faded.
Turning back, Bami couldn't see Dad. Strange legs surrounded them; Dad's cap was nowhere. Tears gathered in their eyes.
Then Dad's words came back. "If you lose me, stop right there!" Bami stopped instead of running around and took a big breath. "It's okay. I can do this."
Dad had given the next step, too. "Call loudly!" Bami spread their wings and shouted with all their strength. "Dad! Bami's here!" People stopped and looked.
From far away came an answer. "Tooooot!" Dad was making a train sound. Bami stayed exactly where they were. No longer afraid, they only had to wait.
Dad's cap appeared between people! He ran over. "Bami!" Bami nestled into his arms. Dad patted their back. "You stopped and called. Well done. Now stay close to Dad!"
"Stay close to Dad!" They walked together to the bakery. Dad bought Bami a bun. Even with balloons bobbing nearby, Bami didn't move one step away.
On the way back, Bami counted. "One, stop right there! Two, call Dad loudly! Three, wait without moving until he comes!" Bami stayed close beside him.
On the train, Dad hugged Bami with his wings. "So brave to stop and call." In crowds, Bami stayed close. "I'm not scared now, Dad!" Stay close to Dad!
